quarterly_data.signal: Micron estimated capital expenditures for property, plant and equipment, net of proceeds from government incentives, of approximately $4.5 billion in the first quarter of 2026, describing that level as a reasonable quarterly baseline for its planned 2026 capital expenditures. For 2025, expenditures for property, plant and equipment were $15.86 billion, partially offset by $2.01 billion of government incentive proceeds; purchase obligations for the acquisition of property, plant and equipment were approximately $1.77 billion as of August 28, 2025, substantially all expected to be paid within one year. Micron states it generally utilizes all of its manufacturing capacity.
quarterly_data.figure: first quarter of 2026 capex ~$4.5 billion (net of government incentives); 2025 PP&E expenditures $15.86 billion; PP&E purchase obligations ~$1.77 billion (August 28, 2025)

quarterly_data.signal: Under the CHIPS Incentives Program, Micron entered into direct funding agreements with the U.S. Department of Commerce in December 2024 providing funds for the construction of fab facilities in Idaho and New York; in June 2025 those agreements were amended to expand its investments, and Micron entered into a direct funding agreement to provide funds to expand and modernize its fab in Virginia. The awards are subject to various conditions and Micron may not receive the funding expected on the same terms or at all.
